posts.title: ECONNREFUSED on every deploy: draining gRPC connections
posts.description: We’ve received customer reports of workers producing bursts of UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED x.x.x.x:xxxx in the logs. UNAVAILABLE is the canonical gRPC transient failure code and ECONNREFUSED is a lower-level TCP error meaning the SYN went out and an RST came back: the destination was reachable, but nothing was listening on the port. posts.title: Load Balancer Gotchas
posts.description: A collection of load balancer surprises I’ve encountered. I’ll add new entries over time. NLB idle timeout silently drops connections # TIL: NLB doesn’t close the connection gracefully after idle timeout > .. no traffic for 350 seconds, then the connection is removed from the NLB flow table.
